scopes.name: read
scopes.what: search companies and people, read what's due and the tasks people wrote, read deals, subscriptions, onboardings and enquiries with what was said in answering them, and read the organisation's settings, its never-contact list and agent guidance included, and what it sells with where each company stands for each

scopes.name: research:write
scopes.what: add companies, facts and suggested contacts (they wait in Research), and leave notes on tasks

scopes.name: drafts:write
scopes.what: write draft notes and emails, marked as written by the agent

scopes.name: outcomes:write
scopes.what: record what happened (added, accepted, sent, called, replied, declined, hold), shown as the agent's

scopes.name: import
scopes.what: push the repo's markdown and pull the snapshot

scopes.name: enquiries:write
scopes.what: record an enquiry or sign-up from your own product or site backend

scopes.name: enquiries:reply
scopes.what: email a reply to whoever sent an enquiry, through your mail server, and record what they said back

scopes.name: customers:write
scopes.what: record and change subscriptions, start their renewals, and start, change and remove onboardings

scopes.name: pipeline:write
scopes.what: work deals (start, value, stage, owner, remove) and say where answering an enquiry stands, who has it, and put its sender on the board

scopes.name: enquiries:triage
scopes.what: say where answering an enquiry stands, who has it, and put its sender on the board, without touching deals

scopes.name: enquiries:delete
scopes.what: delete an enquiry for good, with what was said in answering it

scopes.name: campaigns:write
scopes.what: write campaigns, see who they would go to, and keep the list of addresses marketing mail never goes to

scopes.name: campaigns:send
scopes.what: send a campaign to everyone in conversation or at a customer, through your own mail server, and cancel or resume one

scopes.name: agreements:write
scopes.what: start agreements for companies, upload their documents, and set out who signs them and where; nothing is sent

scopes.name: customers:invite
scopes.what: email a customer a link to their onboarding steps, through your mail server, and withdraw it

scopes.name: contacts:write
scopes.what: add people straight to outreach and change their details and where their conversation stands

scopes.name: research:review
scopes.what: qualify and reject companies, for the organisation or for one thing it sells, pick suggested people for outreach and accept or dismiss details agents found: the review a person otherwise does

scopes.name: people:privacy
scopes.what: export everything held on a person, and erase them for good on their request

scopes.name: enrich:spend
scopes.what: ask the organisation's enrichment vendors, at its cost and within each one's monthly limit, for an email, phone or profile someone lacks; what is found waits to be accepted

scopes.name: tasks:write
scopes.what: start tasks, ask them for more, mark their requests done or not, close and reopen them, and delete the notes agents left on them

scopes.name: agents:run
scopes.what: start and stop Prospector's own agents on tasks

scopes.name: agents:configure
scopes.what: add, change and delete Prospector's own agents, their endpoints, keys and tools

scopes.name: settings:write
scopes.what: change the organisation's settings: its name and colour, waits and wording, the guidance sent to every agent, never-contact list, what it looks for, enquiry sites, onboarding steps, currency, postal address and whether to email only incorporated companies

scopes.name: team:write
scopes.what: add people to the team, change their roles and areas, and take them out: as strong as an owner, since it can make one

scopes.name: mail:configure
scopes.what: set the organisation's outgoing mail server, its username and password

scopes.name: sso:configure
scopes.what: set up single sign-on: the provider, its client secret, the email domains it speaks for and whether it is required

scopes.name: org:export
scopes.what: download everything the organisation holds in one file
